$comment: Bucket Academy branch manifest. Adding a built-in deck = drop a corpus/<file>.json AND add an entry here. app.js loads this at boot (falls back to a built-in copy of this list if the fetch fails). `id` is a stable slug; `file` is relative to corpus/; `pill` is the picker label (the leading 'N · ' part is stripped for headings); `sub` is the picker subtitle. `kind:"language"` decks also declare `languages`. User-generated/custom decks are NOT listed here — they live in localStorage + server sync at runtime.

decks.sub: Learn a language through the ones you know
